note: Chapter names and order fetched from secondary sources mirroring the official CISCE syllabus, because every cisce.org PDF returned HTTP 403 / geo-block on direct fetch (2026-07-06). No block is official-cisce-fetched; all fetched blocks are marked 'fetched-secondary' with the exact URL actually read (shaalaa.com, byjus.com, knowledgeboat.com, icseportal.in, pw.live, and a verbatim rehost of the official CISCE Chemistry PDF on collegedekho.com). Each subject block carries its own 'provenance' field. Topic breakdowns under each real chapter are our own plain-English decomposition where the source listed chapters without sub-topics. Subject mapping to the board's real structure: Classes 6-8 run ONE combined 'Science' subject (id 'science'); Classes 9-10 split Science into three separately examined subjects Physics/Chemistry/Biology (ids 'physics', 'chemistry', 'biology'). What other boards call 'Social Science' is examined by CISCE as TWO separate subjects, so it is stored here as 'History & Civics' (id 'history_civics') and 'Geography' (id 'geography') across all five grades. 'Computer Applications' (id 'computer') is CISCE's real subject name: for Classes 9-10 it is the official Java/OOP elective; for Classes 6-8 CISCE publishes NO official computer syllabus, so those three blocks use a commonly-used publisher/tutor compilation (Vedantu) and say so in their provenance string. Classes 6-8 Mathematics follows CISCE's official 6-unit structure (Number System, Ratio and Proportion / Commercial Arithmetic, Algebra, Geometry, Mensuration, Data Handling) with units as chapters; the previous draft had used CBSE/NCERT chapter titles. Geography Classes 6-8 were likewise fully replaced, as the previous draft had contained CBSE chapters not present in the ICSE syllabus.
